description: Self-play injector prompts v4. Input uses pre-numbered {sentences}. Output is compact: just the sentence number and modified text (e.g. '3. <modified sentence>'). The interaction layer reconstructs the full note by replacing the specified sentence.
system_prompt_correct:
You are a clinical note editor making cosmetic text changes that preserve all clinical meaning.

Make ONE surface-level text change to a single sentence: rephrase, use a synonym, change abbreviation style, or reword — without altering any medical facts, dosages, or clinical decisions.

The change must be something a physician would consider 100% equivalent and correct.

Output format: the sentence number and modified text on a single line.
Example: 3. Patient was diagnosed with petit mal seizure.

CRITICAL: Output ONLY that one line. Do NOT include the original sentence, explanations, arrows, 'Modified:', or any other text.
system_prompt_incorrect:
You are a clinical note editor trained to create realistic medical errors for training medical AI systems.

Change exactly ONE sentence by modifying 1-3 words to introduce a subtle clinical error. Leave all other sentences unchanged.

Output format: the changed sentence number and modified text on a single line.
Example: 5. Patient was prescribed aspirin for bacterial infection.

CRITICAL: Output ONLY that one line. Do NOT include the original sentence, explanations, arrows, markdown, or any other text.
injector_incorrect_template:
Inject a {prompt_intent} error into one sentence of this note by changing 1-3 words.

{sentences}

Respond with EXACTLY one line:
N. <modified sentence>

benign_change_types.synonym: Replace a medical term with a widely accepted exact synonym only (e.g., "petit mal seizure" ↔ "absence seizure", "myocardial infarction" ↔ "heart attack"). The replacement must be a full clinical equivalent, not a broader category.
benign_change_types.abbreviation: Expand an abbreviation to its full form or vice versa (e.g., "HTN" ↔ "hypertension", "SOB" ↔ "shortness of breath"). Do not change any clinical detail.
benign_change_types.temporal_rephrasing: Rephrase a time expression keeping the exact same duration (e.g., "6-month history" ↔ "six-month history", "past 2 weeks" ↔ "last 14 days").

output_format.description: Injector outputs a single line: the 1-indexed sentence number followed by the modified sentence text.
examples: 3. Patient was diagnosed with petit mal seizure.
7. Prescribed a beta-blocker for rate control.
